# Fully pinned, hash-verified dependency closure of cffconvert 2.0.0 for the
# "Validate CITATION.cff" workflow (pip install --require-hashes).
#
# Every package below is pinned to the exact version pip resolves when
# cffconvert 2.0.0 is installed on the workflow target (ubuntu-latest:
# CPython 3.12, glibc, x86_64): the newest release that satisfies every
# version constraint in the transitive closure. cffconvert 2.0.0 is itself the
# latest release, and it is the version that validates CITATION.cff against the
# CFF 1.2.0 schema it bundles.
#
# pip hash-checking mode (--require-hashes) requires a hash for every package
# it installs, so this file lists the sha256 digest of exactly the file pip
# selects on that target. pip normalizes dashes and dots in wheel filenames to
# underscores and chooses the best-matching wheel for the platform; the digests
# here are for those exact files. docopt 0.6.2 publishes no wheel, so its sdist
# is pinned and built instead.
#
# The versions are the latest as of regeneration and the whole closure was
# scanned against the GitHub Advisory Database / OSV (pip-audit): no known
# vulnerabilities.
#
# To update this file, run `bash tools/update_cffconvert_lock.sh` on
# Linux/CPython 3.12, then re-run pip-audit and the workflow's validation
# before committing.
